name: Deep atmosphere
blurb: Gas at one temperature at rest between walls in a uniform field, in exact hydrostatic balance on the grid, over 40 scale heights: the density falls by 10 to the 17 from the bottom to the top. Nothing should move (the view shows the density, on a log scale). Stored as its difference from the column at rest (Reference state: Column), it stays still to the last digit; with the reference off, the rounding of its state sends sound waves up the column that grow as the gas thins, and it stirs itself up within a sound crossing, as it does past about 23 scale heights.

featured.label: Temperature
featured.tip: p / rho. The box holds 1 / T scale heights (the acceleration is 1): 40 at the default 0.025, 80 at 0.0125. Changing it starts the run again
